name: 16mm
description: Super 16 negative: organic grain, gate weave, halation, Kodak-ish tone curve, 1.66:1.
rationale: Super 16 gate is 12.52 mm wide — the sensor is set to match so lens FOV and DOF behave like the real format. Grain is a physical dye-cloud structure: size-varying, strongest in the blue-sensitive layer, so each channel gets its own animated noise at slightly different scale. The film is never perfectly registered in the gate: sub-pixel gate weave via animated translate. Bright sources scatter through the emulsion and reflect off the base, exposing the red-sensitive layer around highlights — halation as a threshold + red-orange glow. Tone curve approximates Kodak Vision3 print contrast with a gentle shoulder.
